content: Sigwey, kuninuways kweiboug nag kawekeimiy mav, peinan anagin mawotet nakaban wasigeis yakamiy.

Deisin-wan min-Pilipay bo iyagagemas, amamwasin, tage nag ka̱gwey; kakapwapout-wan. DaGuyaws bo ilabem mo kadibakeimiy liva̱nen Yowbad, va̱gan bukumwa̱saws kid. Deisin-wan gamag mwasanin isibwademas, tage bo kageiguy.
Mageiguy waseg nag kayaweid; nag sinapun geinawl, nag. Amalivan waseg nag bakakatidaveimiy, nag.

Tage peinan Yowbad itam nanon, idoki kadiloka bisekem liva̱nen bwanabwein, mapuna kageiguy. Nag va̱gan gamag bikalin nuwes; nag. Tage sivinem Yowbad bikalin nuwan. Peinan Yowbad ikakin aveiyag wanuwads nises.
Kuninuways amalivan; nag ka̱teiy ninoumiy amalivan kamnag waseg; nag. Nag tayyaweid yakamey; nag. Nag amalivan kamnag va̱gan bakakwey mivavag; nag. Yowbad ikakin amalivan mounid.

Nag ivag sivinem gamag bikavasimas; nag. Takinew yakamiy, o ven mwasanin gimgilis; nag. Tage bweina bakalivan aveiyag bukusekemas, peinan takaweins liva̱nen Kelis yakamey. Nag gog, yakamey tamma̱num wasigeis yakamiy. Amasinap ma̱wana vin na̱tan bituyes nitun, o bivna̱ses beibwein.
E, nakakalpwa̱kit wasigeis yakamiy; sivinem kid liva̱nen Yowbad bakasekeimiy mo bitamsamwas simayas yakamiy, peinan singay sivinem yakamiy. Atem meivak-wan nakatam pinamiy yakamiy.
Sigwey, kuninuways kweiboug mawotet avakaein wamiven nakases, kawwotet iboug ee... iyam, kaem silma̱nin. Nakasekeimiy bwanabwein liva̱nen Yowbad, tage awoum beivag mimouvit silma̱nin kaem.
Kukwakins-wan, o Yowbad-vak ikakin, igaw simayas yakamiy nitasesus, amasinap bwanabwein, didumwal; nag kayagageimiy tayekelesiys yakamiy; nag.

Kuninuways nakaguyeimiy tatanok tatanok yakamiy, ma̱wana timamiy yakamey; sivinem bakalabeimiy o bakakimtuweimiy va̱gan amisinap beibwein mo bikalin nuwan Yowbad. Peinan bo ikatigikeids silma̱nin nakaleiwag son nakamnat.

Sigwey, tut babaw ikalin nuwem Yowbad waseg, peinan liva̱nen Yowbad nakalivan nukuliganes, nag mamagina gamag asilivan; nag. Peinan kukwakinsa Yowbad anilivan tatonen. Nukuliganes liva̱nen Yowbad, kuninuways mo nukusimounids waseg. Kusimounids mo nukutakayasis tasiyas tayekelesiys. E, nukutakayasis asisinap min-Yudiy tasiyas niyakelesiys Yeisuw Kelis waseg, peinan miven gimgilis bo iyagageimiy yakamiy, ma̱wan-vak Yudiy gimgilis niyagages Yowbad angamag tasiyas.

Min-Yudiy kweiboug neiweiys tasiyas palopits, wankuyeim-vak daGuyaws Yeisuw neiweiys. Wankuyeim mo ikayabemas yakamey. Yowbad igeg nanon wasigeis min-Yudiy tasiyas, peinan tasilabods. E, sivines bisilbwadem; mata ge bakasekeimiy liva̱nen Yeisuw, tobwag ven gimgilis yakamiy, mo Yowbad bikatinabweimiy. Singay ikatimweis asisinap kalbaleb mo ivakaein. Nakabiyokous waseg, Yowbad ankavikun mo ilivatus tasiyas.
Sigwey, nakalisaweimiy tut kadiyakus waseg, tage nuwaneimiy singaya wasigeis yakamey nises. Sivinem kid vayuwein bakaw kalakwaneimiy.
Yey Pawl tut babaw ayyokon, bo nag. Peinan Seitan bo isilbwed maked.

Nuwaneimiy singaya wasigeis yakamey nises. Igaw daGuyaws Yeisuw beiyum beim, nag kalisiy wasigeis bakamwa̱saw; misinaka yakamiy. E, kannamis va̱gan igaw avei-tut Yeisuw beiyum beim, mo beimwan wom wasigeis yakamiy.
